description:
How you can make an impact

• Familiarity with TCMS architecture concepts such as CAN and TRDP

• Basic Python skills or genuine interest in developing them

• Ability to analyze and understand software using Function Block Diagrams (FBD)

• Experience with version control systems for software and documentation, including GitLab or SVN

• Working fluency in English and German

• Ability to clearly explain technical concepts and contribute to knowledge exchange in a collaborative, cross-functional team

• Proactive problem‑solver, comfortable with exploring questions, proposing solutions, and adapting approaches when challenges arise

• Strong interest in leveraging data to improve maintenance

Your Experience

• Experience in developing analytics solutions and a proven track record of implementing them to optimize complex industrial processes or enhance asset performance in real-world environments

• Python skills or genuine interest in developing them

Beneficial skills

• Experience with Selectron tools

• Experience supporting or managing projects, coordinating technical teams to deliver within scope, timeline, and resource constraints

• Experience creating or guiding visualizations that support effective decision‑making for engineering, maintenance, and business teams

• Experience or interest in assessing technical and operational risks, including cyber‑related threats, and supporting mitigation planning across the digital value chain
